ceiling_statement: FROZEN GUARANTEE. For a declared toolchain commitment T, the maximum feasible architecture-to-source-to-executable assurance is a refinement chain in which every link is either (a) a machine-checked proof replayable offline by a small proof-checker kernel, or (b) recompute-and-compare conformance between independently produced artifacts (translation validation / diverse re-verification), terminating in an explicitly enumerated, minimized, hash-committed Trusted Computing Base (proof checker, compiler+runtime image, OS loader, hardware). No system transports a property to the executable with a smaller trust residue than this TCB, and no property is transported beyond what the weakest link carries. SUPERIOR TRANSPORT NAMED (supreme-law rule 3 declaration): a strictly smaller trust residue is reachable TODAY by retargeting the trusted kernel to a verified-compilation substrate — CakeML (verified, bootstrapped, offline-obtainable) or the Brack verified Scheme compiler built on it — which removes the diverse-double-execution mitigation from the compiler link entirely; for a deployment whose declared toolchain is an unverified compiler (e.g. a Common Lisp commitment, for which no verified compiler exists), link-type (b) is the optimum FOR THAT COMMITMENT, and the exclusion of the verified substrate is a declared scope choice of the creator, not a limit.
derivation: Verification theory: every proof chain bottoms out in an unverified checker plus hardware — the TCB is irreducible, only minimizable (a self-verifying checker is circular; Goedel II blocks self-certified consistency). Thompson's trusting-trust result: compiler trust cannot be discharged by source inspection alone; the mitigations are a verified compiler, diverse double-compilation, or independent re-execution of artifact-level claims. For a toolchain WITH a verified compiler substrate available (CakeML/Brack-class, which exists and is obtainable offline today), the compiler link becomes link-type (a) and the TCB strictly shrinks; for a declared toolchain WITHOUT one, link-type (b) is the optimum for the compiler link. Information-theoretic: a property claim about the executable carries at most the information transported through the chain; any claim exceeding the conjunction of link guarantees is unverifiable assertion (H8). Therefore ceiling = machine-checked links where a checker exists + recompute-and-compare links elsewhere + committed enumerated TCB — RESOURCE_BOUNDED because the verified substrate strictly shrinks the TCB and its exclusion is only a declared commitment.
relativity_note: Relative to the declared toolchain commitment. The frozen statement names the superior transport (CakeML/Brack verified-compilation substrate) as required by the supreme law when scope delivers less than the maximum; adopting it is a creator decision recorded outside this instrument.
lean_obligation: Define artifacts A (architecture spec), S (source model), E (executable image), a finite committed TCB, transported properties P over traces, refinement as trace inclusion. Prove per-link and compose: Refines S A and Conforms E S imply, assuming TCB, every transported property holds of E — where Refines is machine-checked and Conforms is the recompute predicate (load-time audit and independent re-verification returned equal digests), carried as an axiom-tagged hypothesis inside the TCB assumptions so the trust residue is syntactically visible: no conclusion about E exists outside the Assuming TCB context. Substrate-comparison lemma: under a verified-compiler hypothesis for the kernel's compilation, the Conforms axiom for that link is discharged and the TCB term strictly shrinks — the superiority of the named transport as a theorem schema, not prose.

attainment_witness_appendix.candidate_mechanism: For the declared SBCL commitment: (1) formalize the 9 admission-kernel theorems in Lean 4 (offline vendored toolchain, sidestepping the network-blocked F*/EverParse/Perennial route); proof objects + the small Lean kernel become release artifacts; (2) extend trusted-toolchain-manifest.sexp to hash the exact SBCL binary, Lean kernel, and OS loader, binding the enumerated TCB into the census chain; (3) generate the runtime dispatch/architecture table FROM the spec, keeping map-equals-implementation enforcement as the recompute link; (4) load-time conformance audits generalized from the FSM coverage-gate pattern; (5) kernel-diversity independent re-verification (release-spine + staged L6 verifier) as the diverse-execution mitigation for the unverified compiler link; (6) hand-written strict CDDL parser cross-checked against an independent decoder. The CakeML/Brack retargeting of the trusted kernel is the recorded superior alternative awaiting explicit creator approval per the collaboration protocol.
